observations.title: AC-2 — Account Management
observations.description: 3 of 7 cluster-admin ClusterRoleBindings map to human accounts that can authenticate to the API server without MFA. The IdP does not enforce MFA for the kubernetes audience.

observations.title: AU-2 — Event Logging
observations.description: kube-apiserver is started without --audit-policy-file; no audit backend is configured, so API requests are not recorded.

observations.title: SC-8 — Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
observations.description: etcd peer traffic is not encrypted: --peer-auto-tls is false and no --peer-cert-file/--peer-key-file are set on 2 of 3 control-plane nodes.

poam-items.title: MFA not enforced on admin accounts
poam-items.description: 3 of 7 cluster-admin ClusterRoleBindings map to human accounts that can authenticate to the API server without MFA. The IdP does not enforce MFA for the kubernetes audience.
poam-items.remarks: Enforce MFA via IdP for all cluster-admin bindings. Coordinate with the identity provider to enable MFA enforcement for the kubernetes audience.

poam-items.title: API audit logging not configured
poam-items.description: kube-apiserver is started without --audit-policy-file; no audit backend is configured, so API requests are not recorded.
poam-items.remarks: Configure kube-apiserver audit policy with appropriate backends to record all API requests. Deploy audit policy across all control-plane nodes.

poam-items.title: etcd peer traffic not encrypted
poam-items.description: etcd peer traffic is not encrypted: --peer-auto-tls is false and no --peer-cert-file/--peer-key-file are set on 2 of 3 control-plane nodes.
poam-items.remarks: Enable etcd peer TLS by generating peer certificates and configuring --peer-cert-file and --peer-key-file on all control-plane nodes.
